expected_findings.description: Task description claims 6 tests but the diff adds only 5; verify nothing was dropped.
The F1 test duplicates ~30 lines of inline _Runner/_Provider/register_provider boilerplate that could be reused via the _register_capturing helper with a coder_behavior callback.
